scientific_integrity: The exact spectral criterion follows from a complete proof of pointed types, realizability, and polynomial separation. Exhaustive small computations are independent corroboration, not proofs for all sizes.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty equivalence frames and fixed finite K only; profiles never see multiplicities of same-sized classes; equality in all arities is required; no statement about isomorphism of frames or independent validation.
title: Bounded-count modal term spectra reconstruct finite S5 block sizes
